_format: tips shown on the loading card. text: {action} is replaced with its key. where: '' = anywhere, else a substring of the scene path being loaded.

tips.text: Press {spot} to pause the tape. A frozen frame shows what a moving one hides.
Night vision ({night_vision}) drains the camcorder battery. Spare cells turn up in drawers and cabins.
Hold {objectives} to see what is left to do tonight.
Crouch ({crouch}) somewhere small and dark. Not everything that watches looks down.
A red light in the dark is usually a standby LED. Usually.
When the picture starts to roll, something is close to the lens.
Read everything you pick up. Old paper remembers more than people do.
Whatever follows you on these tapes never hurries. Do not stand still.
Use {interact} to turn things over. Dates, names, phone numbers: look closely.
Somewhere on every tape, it is 3:12.
Nobody wrote a name on these tapes. Nobody ever does.
Between tapes the room needs looking after too. Maa's messages will not wait forever.
The box gives out the tapes in its own order.
Watchman's duty: every visitor signs the register, with the time. Every one.
Shanti Vihar has four wings, A to D. The CCTV in the cabin sees what the patrol misses.
The intercom in the cabin rings every flat. Some flats ring back.
